title: Upgrade the CARS
desc: Upgrade the CARS is a 3D driving game where every gate you pass makes your ride better &mdash; or worse. Steer your car through the green plus gates to boost your engine, body and speed, and dodge the red minus ones that strip your upgrades away. Reach the end of the track with the strongest car you can build, then cash it in. Spend your earnings on new parking spots, unlock fresh cars in the garage, and repaint them in the texture shop. Every run funds the next one. Push far enough and the road stops being empty &mdash; giant kaiju block the way, and you will need weapons to clear them. Collect money on every lap
howto: Drag with the mouse or swipe on touch to steer your car left and right Drive through the plus gates to upgrade and avoid the minus gates Tap the on-screen buttons to buy upgrades sell cars and unlock new spots
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
